data.name: Umamah
data.long_meaning: The name Umamah is derived from the Arabic word ‘Ummah’ meaning ‘community of believers’. In Islamic tradition, Umamah refers to the mother of the believers, a title given to Aisha bint Abu Bakr, who was one of the wives of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Umamah carries deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. Aisha bint Abu Bakr was known for her unwavering faith and dedication to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the Muslim community. The name Umamah is a reminder of the importance of community and faith in the Islamic way of life.

in_arabic.name: أُماة
in_arabic.long_meaning: أُماة النبى محمد، هي المُؤمِنَة الأُولى، والخادمة الأُولى، وتُعد مُصدرَ لأسماءِ الأُمورِ والخُطوبِ والأُسَرِ، وتُستخدم كُنيةً للمُؤمِنَةِ الفاضلةِ، وتُشيرُ إلى أُمّها المُؤمِنَةِ الفاضلةِ، وسمّى النبى محمد هذه الصفةَ لِلمُؤمِنَةِ الأُولىِ، وتُستخدم هذه الصفة في القرآن الكريم

in_hindi.name: उम्माह
in_hindi.long_meaning: उम्माह या उम्मा, यह नाम पवित्र भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप में एक प्रसिद्ध नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है मातृभूमि या गृहस्थी. यह नाम मुस्लिम परिवारों में बहुत प्रसिद्ध है

in_english.name: Umamah
in_english.meaning: Her prophet's community, the first Muslim community, devoted servant, or devoted mother
in_english.long_meaning: Umamah is the title given to the first Muslim, devoted servant, or devoted mother. It is derived from the Arabic root 'umm', which means 'mother'. In Islamic tradition, Umamah refers to the first Muslim community, the devoted servant, or the devoted mother. The term Umamah is used in the Quranic verse 24:31, which describes the virtues of the devoted servant.

data.cultural_impact: The title 'Ummah' reflects the deep sense of brotherhood and community among Muslims. The word is used to denote the entire Muslim ummah or community of believers, stressing the importance of unity among believers. In this modern era where divisions and sectarianism are prevalent, the name Umamah serves as a reminder of the need for solidarity and brotherhood.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Umamah holds deep spiritual significance as it refers to Aisha bint Abu Bakr, one of the most revered figures in Islamic history. Aisha was an accomplished scholar, a Sahabiyat (companion of the Prophet), and a role model for Muslim women. Her memory and legacy continue to inspire generations of Muslims, embodying values such as piety, devotion, and commitment to knowledge. For those named Umamah, it carries a responsibility to uphold the qualities and values of Aisha bint Abu Bakr, and to strive for excellence in their personal and spiritual lives.
